# Resource: tfe_stack_variable_set

Manages associations between variable sets and stacks.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe_organization_test = tfe.organization.Organization(self, "test",
            email="admin@company.com",
            name="my-org-name"
        )
        tfe_stack_test = tfe.stack.Stack(self, "test_1",
            name="my-stack-name",
            project_id=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_organization_test.default_project_id)
        )
        # This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.
        tfe_stack_test.override_logical_id("test")
        tfe_variable_set_test = tfe.variable_set.VariableSet(self, "test_2",
            description="Some description.",
            name="Test Varset",
            organization=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_organization_test.id)
        )
        # This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.
        tfe_variable_set_test.override_logical_id("test")
        tfe_stack_variable_set_test = tfe.stack_variable_set.StackVariableSet(self, "test_3",
            stack_id=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_stack_test.id),
            variable_set_id=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_variable_set_test.id)
        )
        # This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.
        tfe_stack_variable_set_test.override_logical_id("test")
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stack_id` (String) The ID of the stack to which to add the variable set.
- `variable_set_id` (String) The ID of the variable set to add to the stack.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the stack variable set association in the format `stack/varset`.



## Import

Resource tfe_stack_variable_set can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <STACK ID>/<VARSET ID>
terraform import tfe_stack_variable_set.test st-abcdefgh/varset-ijklmnop
```
